'''Tallo ''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. Stationed on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he ran a small shop, where he built and sold [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and other weaponry.<ref name="TOR" />
